name: Scrapewise
tagline: Live product and price data from any online store, for e-commerce teams and AI agents
description: Scrapewise is a remote MCP server and live product-data source for e-commerce teams and AI agents. It is not an LLM product: agents call Scrapewise over Streamable HTTP to retrieve current product details and prices from online stores. A standard API and managed data service are also available. The free trial includes five requests; pay-as-you-go pricing is €0.15 per 1,000 requests, top-ups start at €5, and managed service starts at €1,500/month.
